description: An older 1x1 card with no 5 GHz radio: 2.4 GHz congestion is the whole story.
note: A single-stream, single-band card has no 5 GHz escape hatch, so everything it does competes in the one crowded band. That makes a smaller improvement worth chasing than it would be on a dual-band laptop, which can simply move the traffic upstairs. Nothing here is specific to any machine: it applies to any 802.11n 1x1 2.4-GHz-only adapter.
